description: This file implements an HTTP handler for retrieving session history, supporting both JSON and Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, with session management, authorization, and real-time updates.

methods.name: resolveSessionHistoryPath
methods.description: Extracts session key from URL path.

methods.name: shouldStreamSse
methods.description: Determines if the request expects SSE streaming based on 'accept' header.

methods.name: getRequestUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL object from the request.

methods.name: resolveLimit
methods.description: Resolves the 'limit' query parameter with bounds.

methods.name: resolveCursorSeq
methods.description: Converts cursor string to sequence number.

methods.name: resolveMessageSeq
methods.description: Extracts sequence number from message metadata.

methods.name: paginateSessionMessages
methods.description: Paginates messages based on limit and cursor.

methods.name: sseWrite
methods.description: Writes an SSE event to response.

methods.name: handleSessionHistoryHttpRequest
methods.description: Main handler for session history HTTP requests, supports JSON and SSE, with authorization and real-time updates.
